caption:
Figure 2. Analysis of real and synthetic image restoration datasets
for various degradations. Existing datasets are small and less di-
verse, especially for haze, low-light, and raindrop. Our diffusion-
generated synthetic data substantially increases the number of
samples as well as scene diversity.
delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the final and initial generated chart and reviewed the original caption and eight source-pair checks. The complete original plot, all seven legend entries, six categories, axes/ticks, exact black/blue percentage annotations and bar geometry are restored at integer 2x. The new title and color-key footer restate the original legend and dataset-size/scene-diversity motivation. No decomposition or arithmetic interpretation is imposed on the ambiguous green/yellow stacking; that source ambiguity remains for real quality scoring. Underlying data values are not reconstructed or redrawn.
